headline.purpose: Double-ruled screen headers; local serif stack.

passage.purpose: Long text above 520px; use passage-phone at narrower widths.

label.purpose: Original Courier New / system monospace interface controls.

motion.name: press-transform
motion.purpose: Original inward press and spring release; page entrance remains disabled.

motion.name: control-colour
motion.value: background-color .16s ease-out, border-color .18s ease-out, color .18s ease-out

assets.provenance: Supplied preexisting company leaf assets; no generated imagery in this design turn.
assets.usage: Install icons and shared leaf mark; preserve aspect ratio.

notes: Palette primitives live only in DESIGN.md frontmatter. No additional tonal scales were introduced.
Dark theme uses the existing :root[data-theme="dark"] overrides in app.css; home navigation uses shade and ink in dark mode.
Component previews emulate is-pressed with :active; app pointer-event behavior remains in js/ui.js.
Legacy hard hover shadows and feedback glyph icons are not canonized. Preview snippets omit those defects.

components.name: Solid-ink button
components.description: Existing selected or pressed emphasis variant; the preview uses CSS active state in place of the app's pointer-event class.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;border:2px solid var(--ink,#000);background:var(--ink,#000);color:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#000);outline-offset:3px;outline-color:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-primary:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-primary:active{transform:translate3d(3px,3px,0) scale(.985)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.3} .ds-primary{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--option-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,.22));backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(120%)}

components.name: Ruled button
components.description: Standard paper action with a strong rule; legacy hard hover shadow is intentionally not a system token.
components.css: .ds-ruled{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;border:2px solid var(--ink,#000);background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#000)}.ds-ruled:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#000);outline-offset:3px}.ds-ruled:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-ruled:active{background:var(--ink,#000);color:var(--paper,#fff);transform:translate3d(3px,3px,0) scale(.985)}.ds-ruled:disabled{opacity:.3} .ds-ruled{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--option-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,.22));backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(120%)}

components.name: Small thin button
components.description: Compact secondary actions, including Settings and passage tools.
components.css: .ds-thin{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:8px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink,#000);background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#000)}.ds-thin:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#000);outline-offset:3px}.ds-thin:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-thin:active{background:var(--ink,#000);color:var(--paper,#fff);transform:translate3d(3px,3px,0) scale(.985)}.ds-thin:disabled{opacity:.3} .ds-thin{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--option-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,.22));backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(120%)}

components.name: Vocabulary home choice
components.description: Original monochrome home button with preserved v1.10 navigation.
components.css: .ds-home{display:block;width:100%;min-height:68px;padding:14px 16px;text-align:left;border:2px solid var(--ink,#000);border-radius:0;background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#000);font:700 16px/1.2 var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out}.ds-home:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#000);outline-offset:3px}.ds-home:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-home:active{transform:translate3d(3px,3px,0) scale(.985)} .ds-home{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--option-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,.22));backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(120%)}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Flexible 16px input with attached ink label and a two-pixel frame.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;border:2px solid var(--ink,#000);color:var(--ink,#000)}.ds-search span{background:var(--ink,#000);color:var(--paper,#fff);padding:11px;font:9px var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:2px}.ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:11px;font:16px var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);background:none;color:inherit;border:0;border-radius:0;caret-color:var(--ink,#000)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#000);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag{display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#000);border-radius:0;color:var(--ink,#000);font:700 10px/1.4 var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}

components.name: Navigation row
components.description: A full-width library row with serif lesson text and pressed shade feedback.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:11px 13px;text-align:left;background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#000);font:700 15px var(--serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Songti SC', serif);border:0;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#000);outline-offset:3px}.ds-row:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-row:active{background:var(--shade,#eee);transform:translate3d(3px,3px,0) scale(.985)} .ds-row{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--option-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,.22));backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(120%)}

components.name: Inline definition
components.description: In-flow meaning panel; surrounding passage continuation is preserved by the app.
components.html:
astronomern.

天文学家
components.css: .ds-definition{padding:18px;border-block:1px solid var(--rule,#999);border-radius:0;background:var(--shade,#eee);color:var(--ink,#000);font:16px/1.6 var(--mono, 'Courier New', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;color:var(--ink,#000)}.ds-heading strong{font-size:22px}.ds-definition .ds-meaning{margin:10px 0;font:700 20px/1.6 var(--cn,'TT SongTi','Songti SC','Songti TC','STSong',serif)}

narrative.overview: User-restored original monochrome paper and Courier aesthetic, retaining v1.10 functions.
keyCharacteristics: Original framed controls and offset shadows
dos: Preserve functional updates and phone/tablet layouts.
donts: Do not restore page flashes or the rejected colour/font redesign.
